correctness.rationale: The exact log-odds update gives L(F1)−L(F2)=L(x)−L(y)+a(x−y), maintaining coordinate order. Solving the diagonal two-cycle gives t=1−2σ and a=8atanh(t)/t, strictly increasing from 8 to infinity. The transverse multiplier at either phase equals Λ=1+h, h=aσ(1−σ), while tangential multiplier 1−h has magnitude <1. In local symmetric/antisymmetric coordinates v grows by Λ times [1+O(center_error+v²)], while center error contracts plus O(v²); before fixed small exit, both perturbation-error sums are bounded geometrically, giving N=log(1/ε)/logΛ+O(1). Finite smooth preperiod from any diagonal start outside the .5 preimage set preserves a positive transverse multiplier. Differentiating h(t) proves γ decreases; σe^(a/4)→1 gives γ~ae^(−a/4). Independent iterates at gains 9,12,20 agreed with bounded-offset clock. No finite test substitutes for local-uniform proof.

final_claim: For the symmetric two-player multiplicative-weights map at gain a>8, all nonexceptional interior diagonal initial points perturbed by ±ε separate to a sufficiently small fixed threshold after N(ε)=log(1/ε)/γ(a)+O(1) original iterations, γ(a)=log[1+aσ_a(1−σ_a)] decreases strictly from log3 to 0 and γ(a)~a exp(−a/4).
limitations: Only a>8, fixed sufficiently small exit threshold, and z not in preimages of 1/2; not time to enter a pure equilibrium.
